text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-72314 fired for hosted-api.p99_latency (eu-west). Current p99=1.35s, SLO burn 18% over 5m. Affected route: /v1/generate. pd_incident_id=PD-72314.

alice-oncall: acked — I'm on it, switching to this thread.

ben: joining. checking console dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/dashboards/latency?region=eu-west — seeing sharp tail.

carla-sre: quick check: model-v2-canary latency spike correlates with new tokenizer rollout ~10m ago. tokenization queue depth high.

frank-sre: running quick query against dataplane logs. tail of requests shows repeated `tokenizer_cold_start` warnings and a backlog spike.

ben: snippet from logs: ```
[eu-west] 2025-11-03T19:21:12Z WARN tokenizer: cold_start_count=124 backlog=82
[eu-west] 2025-11-03T19:21:15Z ERROR serve: request_latency_ms=1350 route=/v1/generate model=model-v2-canary
```

alice-oncall: impact? Any customer errors or just latency?

dave-pm: CS says two enterprise customers reported slow responses (>3s) on chat integrations. No 5xxs reported yet.

eve-cs: confirmed — customers A and B seeing degraded performance, they've been notified. we'll escalate to their CSMs after we have mitigation ETA.

carla-sre: mitigation options: 1) divert eu-west traffic from model-v2-canary -> model-v1b (stable, lower latency), 2) bump dedicated pool by 2 GPUs, 3) warm tokenizers / prime cache, 4) rollback tokenizer change. Recommend (1) + (3) for fastest impact.

ben: I can flip routing rule to fallback variant now. Command: ```
# switch route to stable model
redwoodctl route update --route /v1/generate --region eu-west --model model-v1b --weight 100
```

frank-sre: triggering autoscaler to add 2 nodes and warm cache: ```
kubectl scale deployment/tokenizer --replicas=4 -n redwood-eu
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n redwood-eu -l app=tokenizer -o name); do kubectl exec -n redwood-eu $pod -- /opt/tokenizer/warmup.sh; done
```

incident-bot: PD-72314 status: acknowledged by alice-oncall at 19:23 UTC.

alice-oncall: routed to stable model and kicked cache warmups. monitoring metrics — give it 2–3 mins.

(2m later)

ben: dashboards show p99 dropped from 1.35s -> 0.42s in last 2m for /v1/generate. backlog cleared.

frank-sre: autoscaler added nodes; tokenizer backlog down to single digits. warming appears effective.

carla-sre: noting root cause candidate: tokenizer change introduced an eager cold-start path under certain sequence-lengths. we'll collect traces and open an incident ticket.

dave-pm: customer comms: telling customers A/B we're mitigating and will follow up with a timeline + RCA.

eve-cs: sent interim note. they appreciate the quick response.

alice-oncall: PD-72314 -> marking resolved? I'd like to keep an eye for 15m, then close.

incident-bot: PD-72314 still active — SLO burn down to 2% over 5m.

alice-oncall: ack. I'll hold; Ben, can you follow through with a short rollback PR for tokenizer tweak and Carla, can you own the incident ticket and postmortem?

ben: creating rollback PR now and will smoke-test locally.

carla-sre: will open INC-2025-311, include logs, dashboard links, and list mitigation timeline. I can own the postmortem.

alice-oncall: handing off monitoring to night oncall (frank-sre) at 22:00 UTC. I'll put a note in rotation.

frank-sre: I'm taking the watch — ping me if PD re-fires.

(20m later)

incident-bot: PD-72314 auto-resolved at 19:50 UTC (no new alerts).

alice-oncall: closing the page. Follow-ups: 1) CARLA open postmortem INC-2025-311, 2) BEN merge rollback PR, 3) add a canary telemetry check for tokenizer cold starts to avoid repeat, 4) ops to add a temporary route fallback in runbook.

carla-sre: noted — will file and assign actions.

ben: PR up, will monitor deploy.

alice-oncall: thanks all, great cross-team move. :thumbsup:

dave-pm: filing customer follow-up now.

frank-sre: night oncall here, I'll keep an eye and escalate if anything reappears.

alice-oncall: closing thread — postmortem due EOD tomorrow.
